info.title: Temporary v2 workflow authoring
info.description: Desktop's workflow definition contract served over HTTP. A changed document is saved as the draft and only publish freezes an immutable version; rollback and activate answer the draft they synchronized.

post.description: v2 only, candidate for Cloud. Retries the failed task creation of a failed run's submitted review form. 409 workflow_form_closed when the run is not failed or the form was not submitted; 409 task_handling for a task's handling run (owner decision D30) and 409 task_decomposition for a task decomposition's run (D32), which the task starts again instead; 409 starter_unavailable when the run's recorded starter can no longer act in the workspace (removed or account disabled), as for resume, leaving the run unchanged.

get.summary: Follow when the run changes, as Server-Sent Events
get.description: Only `workflow_run_invalidated` events, the shape of desktop's app event: data `{"runId": "<rid>"}` and no state, so the page reads the run again. One is sent as soon as the stream opens; after that one per committed change, unread ones coalesced. Idle streams carry a `: ping` comment every 15 seconds. 503 workflow_run_events_unavailable when the process has no run host.

get.summary: Follow one node attempt's session events, as Server-Sent Events
get.description: The same stream as chat.openapi.json's conversation events: each message's id is its session sequence and its data a ChatEvent (a turn_ended carries its prompt); an `end` event follows session_ended and `failure` (data `{code}`) reports a broken stream. Any member of the tenant can follow the session; the server checks tenant membership and reads the shared execution session under the run starter's scope. 404 workflow_node_run_not_found when the attempt is not this run's; 404 workflow_node_session_not_found before the attempt was dispatched.

200.description: An event stream of the attempt's session events.

get.description: v2 only, candidate for Cloud. What resuming from failure would do now, desktop's preview_resume with only the keep-files mode: the failed or cancelled nodes it starts from, the Loop and Iteration containers that restart from round 1 in their place, and every node whose attempts it clears. reason names the refusing rule when resumable is false.

post.description: v2 only, candidate for Cloud. Resumes a failed or cancelled run in place from its failed nodes, keeping the workspace files, desktop's resume_from_failure. A refusal is 409 workflow_run_not_resumable with params.reason (run_not_ended, node_running, node_stuck, no_failed_node, review_form, review_form_retry, review_form_submitted, task_handling, task_decomposition, run_settling, starter_unavailable) and params.runningNodeIds. task_handling refuses a task's handling run (owner decision D25) and task_decomposition a task decomposition's run (D32); the task starts handling or decomposing again instead. starter_unavailable refuses a run whose recorded starter, whose identity its Agents execute under, is no longer an active member of the workspace (removed, or the account disabled); a new run starts under its own starter.

Completes a parked interactive Agent node; only the run's starter may (409 run_owned). The gate follows desktop's: the node's payload.interactive.completion lists its blockers; the workflow's own opening turn needs confirmInitialTurn, under completionPolicy agent the Agent's report of the settled turn (completion.agentSignal) needs confirmAgentCompletion, every other blocker (how the turn ended, a missing report, an output that does not fit its schema, the declared completion.files checked in the run's checkout) needs force. 409 workflow_node_incomplete lists the unresolved blockers in params.blockers ({kind, path?, message?}); 409 workflow_node_turn_changed, workflow_node_output_changed and workflow_node_signal_changed refuse, force or not, when the node's settled turn, answer or report is no longer the one it parked with or the one confirmed.

v2-only: queues a human turn on a parked interactive root-scope Agent node, in the node's own session. Only the run's starter may send (409 run_owned); a node whose session was stopped returns 409 workflow_node_session_ended. The answer arrives over the node's session events; the node runs during the turn and parks again after it. The response numbers the accepted message among the starter's messages to the node, as payload.interactive.sent counts them.

v2-only: stops the turn an interactive root-scope Agent node is executing. The node then waits for its starter: when its session outlived the stop (a Node that negotiated turn_cancel keeps it) it accepts further turns, and when the stop ended the session it waits for completion only. The run keeps running. Only the run's starter may stop (409 run_owned); without a turn in flight it returns 409 workflow_node_turn_not_running.

EventCursor.name: after
EventCursor.description: Resume after this session sequence; Last-Event-ID takes precedence.

unappliedSettings.description: Agent nodes, reachable or spare, with the settings a run saves but does not apply; the same names a finished attempt records as `unapplied`. Nodes with none are omitted.

unsupportedNodes.description: Reachable nodes of a known kind that run start refuses (`400 workflow_run_start_failed`, like every other start refusal; desktop does not execute them either). Empty when the root has no Start.

taskId.description: Owning handling or decomposition task, when present.

taskLink.description: How taskId owns the run: as its handling run or as its decomposition's run. Neither resumes from failure or retries its task creation (owner decisions D25, D30, D32); handling or decomposition is started again from the task.

startedByName.description: Starter display name, or empty before the run starts or when unknown. The starter id is the run detail envelope's `startedBy`.
Starter display name, or empty before the run starts or when unknown.

sent.description: The number of the accepted message among the starter's messages to this node. A later payload.interactive.last_turn_error on the node is about the message whose number equals payload.interactive.sent.

runningNodeIds.description: Nodes still executing, which block the resume (reason node_running).

restartContainerNodeIds.description: Loop and Iteration nodes that restart from round 1.

clearNodeIds.description: Every node whose live attempts the resume soft-deletes, sorted: failed nodes, their descendants, and each restarting container with its members. A Loop cleared only as a descendant is listed without its body nodes; its round rows are soft-deleted with it all the same.

rollback.description: v2 keeps the workspace files as they are; desktop's node_files and checkpoint modes are not offered.

containerNodeId.description: The Loop or Iteration that restarts in this node's place.

force.description: v2: complete despite every blocker but turn_unconfirmed; payload.completion_forced records the blockers it covered.

confirmInitialTurn.description: v2: adopt the workflow's own opening turn, which lifts turn_unconfirmed and nothing else. Combined with force it is refused with 400 invalid_request, except under completionPolicy agent for an opening turn that ended normally without a report, where force covers the missing report.

confirmAgentCompletion.description: v2: confirm the Agent's report the starter saw (payload.interactive.completion.agentSignal.signalId), which lifts agent_confirmation_pending and nothing else. Ignored under completionPolicy end_turn.

WorkflowRunVariable.description: One declared variable of the run's root variable pool, desktop's WorkflowRunVariable. value is absent while the variable is unassigned.

WorkflowNodeFailedAttempt.description: An earlier attempt that failed and was run again, desktop's WorkflowNodeFailedAttempt, read from its payload.error_detail. Root Agent automatic retries and resumes from failure replace failed attempts.

iterationConditionDecisions.description: Committed Iteration-region Condition decisions keyed by nodeId#round (zero-based); empty before execution. Loop decisions stay inside each scope state.

conditionDecisions.description: Root-scope Condition decisions keyed by Condition node id: a case id, or `else`, as desktop's run detail. Branch activation is never stored; clients project the nodes behind a branch not taken from these decisions and the node rows.

variables.description: The root variable pool, from the run payload; empty until the run starts.

failedAttempts.description: Earlier failed attempts, oldest first; nodes holds only each node's latest attempt.

startedBy.description: v2-only: the user who started the run, null before it started. Only they can send turns to, stop or complete an interactive node.
